answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with proof-of-personhood stake plus a cost that scales with identity count. A new agent must post a bond sized by its credential, and each additional anonymous identity reuses the same scarce credential, so its bond is divided across siblings. Join a dune of clones and the per-identity stake must be replenished from a single pool, meaning the attacker pays quadratically for each extra vine feeding the same oasis of trust.
